governing_equation: LMTD = (dT1 - dT2)/ln(dT1/dT2); dT1 = Th_in - Tc_out; dT2 = Th_out - Tc_in
inputs_and_units: Four terminal temperatures (any supported temperature unit; converted to K)
output_and_unit: LMTD K; area m2 via exchanger_area
independent_reference: Standard log-mean temperature difference definition (heat-transfer textbooks; DOE heat-transfer handbook identity); 40-digit decimal evaluation
applicability: Single-pass countercurrent screening with constant U and specific heats
exclusions_and_limits: Multipass shells need a supplied LMTD correction F; temperature cross and zero approach rejected; phase change needs its own duty basis

governing_equation: LMTD = (dT1 - dT2)/ln(dT1/dT2); dT1 = Th_in - Tc_in; dT2 = Th_out - Tc_out
Q_hot = H_in - H_out; Q_cold = H_out - H_in (signed)
inputs_and_units: Inlet and outlet enthalpy flows in kW on a common confirmed reference
independent_reference: First-law steady-flow energy balance with no work or losses
applicability: Steady flow; common enthalpy reference confirmed by the user
exclusions_and_limits: No heat loss term; shared utility streams need an explicit allocation fraction; wrong-direction duty stays negative and is rejected downstream

governing_equation: H = dP/(rho*g) with g = 9.80665 m/s2; S = Q*sqrt(H)
inputs_and_units: Flow (volume or mass with density); differential pressure bar and density kg/m3 or supplied head m
applicability: Incompressible liquid; S used only as a costing-chart coordinate
exclusions_and_limits: Not shaft or motor power; no NPSH or curve selection; slurries and non-Newtonian fluids need review

inputs_and_units: Actual volume or mass or molar flow; inlet and reference absolute T K; P bar; Z; MW kg/kmol for mass
output_and_unit: Sm3/h at the stated reference state
independent_reference: Real-gas equation of state PV = nZRT; R = 8.31446261815324 J/mol/K (CODATA 2018 exact)
exclusions_and_limits: Reference state must be stated (no default standard conditions); does not establish a chart's wet/dry or standard basis

governing_equation: Water removed = feed water - product water
inputs_and_units: Water component mass flows of two different streams (any supported mass-flow unit)
independent_reference: Component mass balance over the selected dryer boundary
applicability: Steady dryer boundary with no other water inlets or outlets
exclusions_and_limits: Not a heat duty; ambiguous ton units are refused; total wet flows and other components rejected
